title: नेपाली उखानको पर्यावरणीय अध्ययन {Environmental Studies in the Nepali Proverbs}
nepali: नेपाली उखानको पर्यावरणीय अध्ययन शीर्षकको यस आलेखमा नेपाली उखानलाई पर्यावरणीय समालोचनाका कोणबाट विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । पर्यावरणीय समालोचना भन्नाले मानव र मानवेतर भौतिक तथा जैविक सम्बन्धको अध्ययन हो । प्राकृतिक वातावरणलाई विषय बनाएर साहित्य लेख्ने प्रचलन पुरानो भए पनि मान्छेकै कारण ह्रासोन्मुख बन्दै गएको पर्यावरण र साहित्यिक कर्मलाई एकीकृत गरेर समालोचना गर्ने काम भने नयाँ हो । वैज्ञानिक बुद्धिवादले विविधता, अनेकता र बहुलताको बेवास्ता गरी लालची प्रवृत्ति देखाउँदा जीवजन्तुका बासस्थान खल्बलिएको अवस्थामा मान्छेको प्रकृतिसँग प्रेमपरक सम्बन्ध स्थापना गर्ने हेतुले पर्यावरणीय समालोचना देखा परेको छ । पर्यावरणीय समालोचनाका विशेषता नेपाली उखानमा खोज्नुका साथै प्रकृति र मानवको अन्तक्र्रिया एवम् सम्बन्ध उखानमा कसरी व्यक्त भएको छ भनी अध्ययन गर्ने उद्देश्यले यो आलेख तयार पारिएको हो । नेपाली उखानमा प्रकृतिको संरक्षण, जैविक खानपिन, मानवको आचरण एवं भाषिक व्यवहार आदि पक्षलाई आधार बनाएर नेपाली उखानको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । उखानहरूको सङ्कलन तथा विश्लेषणका लागि आवश्यक सैद्धान्तिक सामग्री पुस्तकालय र अनलाइन माध्यमको उपयोग गरी गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत उखानहरूको विश्लेषण पर्यावरण समालोचनाका आधारमा गरिने भएकाले निगमनात्मक र सैद्धान्तिक कुरालाई उखानबाट पुष्टि गरिएकाले आगमनात्मक विधिको उपयोग गरिएको छ । नेपाली उखानमा प्राणी र वातावरणसँग मानिसको सम्बन्ध खोजी गर्नुका साथै बलियो सम्बन्ध रहेका पक्षहरू र सम्बन्ध कायम हुन नसकेका पक्षहरू केलाउँदै कतिपय उखानहरूमा पर्यावरण मैत्री भाषिक व्यवहार हुन नसकेको निष्कर्ष निकाल्नु यस आलेखको प्राप्ति हो ।
american_english: In this article titled "Environmental Studies in Nepali Proverbs," Nepali proverbs are analyzed from the perspective of environmental criticism. Environmental criticism means the study of the relationship between humans and non-human physical and biological entities. Although the practice of writing literature with the natural environment as its subject is old, the task of criticizing by integrating the environment, which has been degrading because of humans themselves, with literary work is new. Scientific rationalism has shown greed, ignoring diversity, multiplicity and plurality, and environmental criticism has emerged with the intention of establishing a loving relationship between humans and nature while the habitats of living creatures have been disturbed. The purpose of preparing this article is to find the characteristics of environmental criticism in Nepali proverbs, along with studying how the interaction and relationship between nature and humans is expressed in proverbs. In Nepali proverbs, analysis has been done by basing it on aspects such as the conservation of nature, biological food, human conduct and linguistic behavior. The collection and analysis of the necessary theoretical material for proverbs has been done by using the library and online means. Since the analysis of the presented proverbs is to be done on the basis of environmental criticism, and inductive and theoretical matters have been confirmed from proverbs, the inductive method has been used. The achievement of this article is that, while searching for the relationship of humans with animals and the environment in Nepali proverbs and scrutinizing the aspects that have a strong relationship and the aspects that have not been able to establish a relationship, the conclusion is drawn that some proverbs have not been able to have an environment-friendly linguistic behavior.

australian_english: In this article called "Environmental Studies in Nepali Proverbs," Nepali proverbs are looked at through the lens of environmental criticism. Environmental criticism means the study of the relationship between humans and non-human material and biological connections. The practice of writing literature with the natural environment as its subject is old, but the job of criticising by bringing together the environment, which is getting worse because of humans themselves, with literary work is new. Scientific rationalism has shown greed and ignored diversity, multiplicity and plurality, and environmental criticism has emerged with the aim of setting up a loving relationship between humans and nature while the habitats of living things have been disturbed. The point of putting this article together is to find the characteristics of environmental criticism in Nepali proverbs, and to study how the interaction and relationship between nature and humans is expressed in proverbs. Analysis of Nepali proverbs has been done by using aspects like the protection of nature, biological food, human conduct and linguistic behaviour as its basis. The necessary theoretical material for proverbs has been collected and analysed using the library and online means. Since the analysis of the presented proverbs is to be done on the basis of environmental criticism, and deductive and theoretical points have been confirmed from proverbs, the inductive method has been used. What this article has achieved is that, in searching for the relationship of humans with animals and the environment in Nepali proverbs and sifting through the aspects that have a strong relationship and the aspects that have not been able to establish one, the conclusion is reached that some proverbs have not been able to have environment-friendly linguistic behaviour.
informal_english: This article, called "Environmental Studies in Nepali Proverbs," takes a wee look at Nepali proverbs through an environmental criticism lens. Now, environmental criticism is just a fancy way of saying the study of how we humans relate to the non-human material and biological world around us. Writing about nature in literature? That's been done for centuries. But actually criticising by linking the environment — which, let's face it, we've been wrecking — to literary work? That's the new bit. Scientific rationalism has got a lot to answer for: it's ignored diversity, it's ignored variety, it's been greedy. So environmental criticism has come along to try to mend the loving relationship between people and nature, while critters' habitats have been all messed up. The whole point of this article is to find the environmental criticism characteristics in Nepali proverbs, and to see how the interaction and relationship between nature and people gets expressed in them. The analysis has been built around things like looking after nature, biological food, human conduct and how people use language. The theoretical stuff for the proverbs was gathered from the library and online. And since the analysis is going to be done on an environmental criticism basis, and deductive and theoretical points have been confirmed from proverbs, the inductive method has been used. So what's the upshot? Well, when you dig through Nepali proverbs looking for how humans relate to animals and the environment, and you check which aspects have a strong relationship and which ones don't — the conclusion you land on is that some proverbs just don't have environment-friendly language. That's the finding.
